assumption_ledger.note: No evidence in repo_inventory confirms a canary environment exists or is configured for the dashboard summary.
Assume a kill switch mechanism already exists for the dashboard summary feature; no config evidence found.
Assume the shim is a single removable module; no code-level evidence confirms coupling to other components.

dependency_notes.reason: Fixtures must reflect the corrected schema; schema audit must complete first.
Dashboard consumes the translator step-id schema; schema must be stable before enabling.
Dashboard must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema.
Runbook only stabilizes after the summary rollout and rollback shape are known from canary.

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report and shim removal patch
ordered_steps.summary: Audit the translator for schema drift that the legacy parser shim currently masks, then remove the shim so drift is visible in local smoke runs.
ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift and remove legacy parser shim

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dependency-graph fixture set covering new schema
ordered_steps.summary: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures so the plan contract catches ordering regressions once the new schema is in place.
ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the dashboard summary behind a kill switch now that the schema is stable and fixtures are in place.
ordered_steps.title: Enable translated release-plan dashboard summary

ordered_steps.summary: Finalize the operator runbook and launch checklist after the summary path is proven in canary.
ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist

mitigations: Keep kill switch on dashboard summary until canary proves stability
Gate dashboard behind fixture validation so missing fixtures block deployment
Run schema-drift audit in CI so regressions are caught before merge
primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect step order to users if schema drift is not resolved before the summary is enabled.
